chapter_title: Export Oriented Units (EOUs), Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTPs), Software Technology Parks (STPs) and Bio-Technology
title: Change of Location / Inclusion of Additional Location with BOA

business_rules.rule_description:
6.35 Change of Location / Inclusion of Additional Location with BOA
Approval
BOA may consider change of location of EOU / EHTP / STP / BTP unit from place
mentioned in Lo P to another and / or to include additional location outside
territorial jurisdiction of original DC / Designated Officer, subject to such
conditions as BOA may decide.
